intro.en: Build layered sequence figures in R with ggplot2: compare multiple sequences, annotate a circular map, inspect HSP alignments and connect independent views.
intro.zh: 基于 ggplot2 的 R 可视化包：比较多序列关系、组织单序列注释、展示 HSP 比对，并组合全局与局部视图。

multi-purpose.en: Compare sequence intervals, gene order and observed relationships.
multi-purpose.zh: 比较序列区间、基因顺序与已有连接关系。

circular-purpose.en: Place features, primers and restriction sites on one sequence.
circular-purpose.zh: 在一条序列上组织特征、引物和限制位点。

dotplot-purpose.en: Inspect alignment intervals on query and subject axes.
dotplot-purpose.zh: 在 query 与 subject 双轴上查看比对区间。

fusion-purpose.en: Connect independent plots through explicit source intervals.
fusion-purpose.zh: 用明确的来源区间连接独立图形。

grammar.en: The multi-sequence module has four Coord types. Circular and Dotplot add two more; Fusion is the composition layer. Layers, mappings, scales, positions and themes retain their ggplot2 roles.
grammar.zh: 多序列模块包含四种 Coord；Circular、Dotplot 各有专属坐标系，Fusion 负责组合独立图形。图层、映射、标度、局部位置与主题各司其职，沿用 ggplot2 的绘图语法。

chord-title.zh: Chord · 四条基因组的关系总览

chord-caption.en: Combine mixed-curvature backbones, strand-aware CDS arrows, selected source labels and Identity-coloured ribbons. Features and HSPs are display subsets of the original records.
chord-caption.zh: 混合曲率骨架、保留真实链方向的 CDS 箭头、来源标签与 Identity 连接带组合展示。特征与 HSP 按显示需要从原始记录中选取。

chord-alt.en: Four-genome Chord flagship with labelled genes and alignment ribbons
chord-alt.zh: 四条基因组的弦图旗舰：基因标签与比对连接带

linear-title.en: Collinear · order, orientation and cross-row links
linear-title.zh: Collinear · 顺序、方向与跨行连接

linear-caption.en: Compare four genomes on a shared base-pair scale. Selected CDS sit on either side of each backbone; dashed outlines distinguish links across non-adjacent rows.
linear-caption.zh: 在共同的 bp 标尺下比较四条基因组，骨架两侧展示精选 CDS。跨越非相邻显示行的连接带使用虚线轮廓。

linear-alt.en: Four-genome Collinear flagship with strand-separated genes and cross-row ribbons
linear-alt.zh: 四条基因组的共线性旗舰：分链基因与跨行连接带

circular-caption.en: A complete circular map with 20 features, five reference primers and 58 grouped cut positions from the declared enzyme set. Original sequence positions and annotation identities are retained.
circular-caption.zh: 完整圆图包含 20 个特征、5 个参考引物，以及声明酶集合中的 58 个合并切点位置。序列位置与注释身份均来自原始输入。

circular-alt.en: pETDuet-1 circular flagship with features, primers and restriction sites
circular-alt.zh: pETDuet-1 圆图旗舰：完整特征、引物与限制位点

more-views.zh: HSP 矩阵与多视图组合

dotplot-alt.zh: 四序列、32 条原始 HSP 的双轴矩阵

fusion-alt.en: Linked Chord, Collinear, Radial and local-detail views
fusion-alt.zh: 连接 Chord、Collinear、Radial 与局部放大的组合图

dotplot-caption.en: 32 original HSPs; Identity by colour, reported alignment length by line width.
dotplot-caption.zh: 32 条原始 HSP；颜色表示 Identity，线宽表示原记录中的比对长度。

fusion-caption.en: Global relationships, ordered comparisons and a magnified source interval in one composition.
fusion-caption.zh: 在同一组合中关联全局关系、共线性比较与来源区间的局部放大。

source-note.en: Figures share traceable inputs and plot definitions. See the source records and reproduction notes:
source-note.zh: 图像的输入、显示选择与绘图定义均可追溯：

optional-deps.en: The minimal example below needs only ggchord. Complete data-preparation examples declare optional dependencies such as dplyr, purrr and tidyr alongside their code.
optional-deps.zh: 下面的最小示例只需加载 ggchord。完整数据整理示例会在代码旁声明 dplyr、purrr、tidyr 等可选依赖。

quick-intro.en: Use bundled tables to draw sequence backbones, alignment ribbons and sequence names. No file download or alignment program is needed.
quick-intro.zh: 使用随包表格绘制序列骨架、比对连接带和序列名称，无需下载文件或运行比对程序。

quick-note.en: This small example shows the layer grammar. The figures above add their own source annotations, display choices and styling.
quick-note.zh: 这段最小示例展示图层组合方式。上方综合图进一步加入了对应的来源注释、显示选择和样式。

output-intro.en: Preview and save at the same explicit dimensions so labels are arranged for the intended figure size.
output-intro.zh: 按相同的明确宽高预览并保存，让标签按预定成图尺寸排布。

inspiration-grammar.en: Provides the layered grammar and the division of responsibilities between mappings, scales, guides, geometry, coordinates and themes. ggchord follows this model so users can compose layers and supply their own scales and styles.
inspiration-grammar.zh: 提供分层绘图语法，以及映射、标度、图例、几何、坐标与主题的职责划分。ggchord 沿用这一模型，让用户组合独立图层，并使用自己的标度和样式。

inspiration-naming.en: Informs the compact query/subject field names used to trace alignment records, endpoints and sequence identifiers. Plotting consumes existing results rather than running an alignment program.
inspiration-naming.zh: 为紧凑的 query/subject 字段命名提供参照，便于追踪比对记录、端点与序列标识。绘图读取已有结果，不在绘图阶段运行比对程序。

inspiration-circular.en: Provide references for circular information hierarchy, restrained ribbon display, multi-track organization and the reading order of sequence relationships. These ideas inform the arrangement of backbones, annotations and links.
inspiration-circular.zh: 为环形信息层级、克制的连接带表达、多轨道组织及关系阅读顺序提供参照，帮助组织序列骨架、注释与连接之间的层次。

inspiration-synteny.en: Offer clear examples of strand-aware gene arrows, gene-cluster comparisons and linear synteny. They inform how sequence direction, feature placement and connections are presented together.
inspiration-synteny.zh: 为保留链方向的基因箭头、基因簇比较和直线共线性提供清晰范例，帮助协调序列方向、特征位置与连接关系的表达。

inspiration-features.en: Provides a reference for readable feature annotations, crowded-label handling and local feature layouts. It informs the emphasis on connecting labels clearly to their source intervals.
inspiration-features.zh: 为可读的特征注释、拥挤标签处理和局部特征布局提供参照，帮助明确标签与其来源区间之间的对应关系。

inspiration-preview.en: Informs the workflow of previewing a static figure at its intended export size. ggchord uses view_ggchord() for sized preview and standard ggsave() for saving.
inspiration-preview.zh: 为按预定导出尺寸检查静态图形提供流程参照。ggchord 用 view_ggchord() 进行指定尺寸预览，用标准 ggsave() 保存。

radial-title.zh: Radial · 径向辐条上的共线性

radial-caption.en: Derived from the Chord flagship, using its source preparation and selected features. Radial backbones expose interval relationships while preserving sequence identities and native positions.
radial-caption.zh: 从弦图旗舰复用来源准备与精选特征，改用径向辐条骨架展示区间关系；序列身份与原生位置保持可追溯。

radial-alt.en: Radial flagship derived from the four-genome Chord example
radial-alt.zh: 从四基因组弦图派生的 Radial 旗舰

sankey-title.en: Sankey · source intervals across two mirrored columns
sankey-title.zh: Sankey · 镜像双列中的来源区间

sankey-caption.en: Derived from the Collinear flagship, retaining its selected genes and HSPs. Mirrored sequence columns show observed interval relationships; ribbon width is not a conserved flow quantity.
sankey-caption.zh: 从共线性旗舰派生，保留对应的精选基因与 HSP。序列镜像排列在两列中，连接带表示已有区间关系，带宽不代表守恒流量。

sankey-alt.en: Sankey flagship derived from the four-genome Collinear example
sankey-alt.zh: 从四基因组共线性图派生的 Sankey 旗舰

inspiration-grammar-title.zh: 绘图语法与序列关系表达

inspiration-features-title.en: Gene arrows, annotation placement and local comparison
inspiration-features-title.zh: 基因箭头、注释布局与局部比较

inspiration-genomes.en: Informs tidy multi-table inputs, focus/sync workflows, feature stacking, local anchoring and local display reversal. Its approach helps keep data preparation distinct from display choices.
inspiration-genomes.zh: 为 tidy 多表输入、focus/sync 工作流、特征堆叠、局部锚定与局部显示翻转提供参照，帮助区分数据整理和显示选择的职责。

inspiration-detail-title.en: Local magnification, aligned characters and figure preview
inspiration-detail-title.zh: 局部放大、对齐字符与图形预览

inspiration-magnify.en: Provides a reference for connecting an overview to a magnified inset. ggchord develops this presentation idea around explicit source intervals and independently registered sequence views.
inspiration-magnify.zh: 为整体图与局部放大图之间的关联表达提供参照。ggchord 围绕明确的来源区间和独立注册的序列视图发展这一表达方式。

inspiration-alignment.en: Inform design studies of DNA/protein alignment displays, character colouring and composition with ggplot2 graphics, especially the relationship between alignment columns, gaps and character-level detail.
inspiration-alignment.zh: 为 DNA、蛋白对齐显示、字符着色及与 ggplot2 图形组合提供设计研究参照，尤其关注对齐列、gap 与字符细节之间的对应关系。

inspiration-columns.en: Provide comparison references in character-view design studies: sequence-logo semantics, alignment-column annotations, consensus and conservation displays, and the relationship between per-column summaries and individual sequences.
inspiration-columns.zh: 在字符视图的设计研究中，用于比较序列 logo、对齐列注释、共识与保守性的表达方式，以及逐列统计与单条序列之间的关系。

inspiration-intro.en: The following projects inform ggchord’s graphical grammar, sequence layouts and detail views. Each entry describes the aspect that influenced the design.
inspiration-intro.zh: 以下项目为 ggchord 的绘图语法、序列布局与细节视图提供设计灵感，各项分别说明具体的启发方向。
